gen-gf-stack-sans-headline-fs-karma: Karma keeps its terminals well clear of the stem, classic and trustworthy. Karma lets its light strokes recede only slightly, a quiet texture under Stack Sans Headline, whose lines hold one constant width like neon glass.
gen-gf-ubuntu-mono-fs-erode: Rigid, hairline-free letters up top, softly modulated ones below. Ubuntu Mono keeps every stroke at matching thickness while Erode swells and thins gently, and that gap between them is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-noto-znamenny-musical: Underdog bends every curve at one nib width and opens its round letters like horseshoes. Noto Znamenny Musical Notation, a sans-serif with terminals stopping far from the stem, gives that loud heading a clean, modern counterweight.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Huge lowercase eyes and daylight inside every curve define Unica One, whose strokes never vary in thickness. Noto Sans Buginese feels modern beside it, its open letter mouths like chalk arcs left unjoined.
gen-gf-victor-mono-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Victor Mono lays bold letters out like chalk marks on a slate, never swelling or thinning. Be Vietnam Pro, strokes like a bent steel rod, is the smoother voice, and that contrast in temperament is the draw.
gen-gf-victor-mono-fs-ranade: Chalk-mark spacing and bold, unvarying strokes give Victor Mono a technical, precise look. Ranade, a sans-serif with hairlines that stay sturdy next to its stems, adds a slightly organic, widely spaced texture below.
gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-archivo: Friendly, hand-lettered Waiting for the Sunrise nests its characters like links in a chain, with an open lower curve on the g. Archivo, with its commanding x-height, makes the strongest anchor, built for quick looks.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Loud, see-through lettering: Wallpoet lets the paper show between its letters. Be Vietnam Pro brings strokes like a bent steel rod, with curve endings that never crowd each other, and a high mean line.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Wallpoet curves without a snag, its lowercase rising high. Noto Sans Buginese, a sans-serif with open letter mouths like chalk arcs left unjoined, gives that display shout a modern, contemporary partner.
gen-gf-walter-turncoat-fs-karma: Relaxed, marker-steady lettering: Walter Turncoat has the casual ease of tubular copper-pipe strokes. Karma handles the steadier work, a soft cadence of fuller stems and slimmer links that feels trustworthy.
